post.description:
Create a new wardrobe item and enqueue AI processing for metadata generation.

- **image_url**: URL to the item image (required)
- **category**: Optional category hint (top, bottom, dress, shoes, outerwear, accessory)
- **name**: Optional item name

The endpoint creates a basic item immediately and returns a job_id for tracking AI processing.
AI will generate comprehensive metadata including:
- Basic info: name, description, category
- Visual attributes: colors, pattern, fabric
- Context: occasion, weather, season, mood
- Styling metadata: formality_score, warmth_level, visual_weight, versatility_score
- Physical attributes: color_code, fit_code, pattern_type
- Human readable ID generation

post.summary: Generate starter wardrobe from onboarding inputs
post.description:
Deterministic 30-60 item starter wardrobe per WGS §6.2.

Auth required: user_id is taken from the authenticated user, not body.
Idempotent: re-running replaces prior auto-generated clones (WGS §13 Q5).
Rate limit: 5 requests/minute per IP (matches API_DOCUMENTATION.md).

Generate `count` outfit recommendations for the authenticated user.

Spec §6.1 — POST /api/v05/recommendation/build. Stateless engine;
identical (input, seed) returns identical outfits. Phase 2 additionally
caches `primary + alternates` for the `/try_another` flow.

Variation outfit per AU-252 §19 (1-axis controlled).

Phase 3 implements the cache-hit path only: pool from /build is filtered
and scored; the top candidate is returned. Pool exhaustion produces a
`fallback=true` response with `outfit=None`; Phase 4 will replace this
with engine recompose.

Errors:
- 401: missing/invalid JWT.
- 410 `{code: session_expired}`: Redis session missing/expired. Mobile
  should silently fall back to POST /build to start a new session.
- 422 `{code: stale_hash}`: `current_outfit_hash` not in session history.
- 429: rate limited (60 req/min per IP).

User picked one of the served outfits.

Records `picked_ts = now` and (optionally) the originating `build_ts`
so time-to-decision can be computed at query time.
User marked outfit as worn (24h prompt response).
User closed session without picking an outfit.

Submit post-wear feedback (photo and/or text) for one outfit.

Flow:
  1. Rate-limit by client IP (20/min).
  2. Require at least one of `text` or `photo_b64` (else 400).
  3. Call LLM-2 to extract structured style signals.
  4. If confidence >= 0.3, persist signals via repository.
  5. Return 204 No Content.

Errors from LLM-2 / persistence MUST NOT propagate — feedback is
fire-and-forget from the mobile's perspective. Same never-raise
contract as v05_outcome.

AbandonEventRequest.title: AbandonEventRequest
AbandonEventRequest.description: User closed session without picking any outfit.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: Server-issued session ID (UUIDv4). Populated when the V05 try_another session cache write succeeds. Clients pass this back to POST /try_another. Null if the cache write failed (degraded stateless mode).

wardrobe_gap.title: Wardrobe Gap
wardrobe_gap.description: True when even SYSTEM common-items catalog cannot fill the climate-starved slot. When True, `outfits` is empty and the client should render a wardrobe-gap CTA per the reason code.

wardrobe_gap_reason.description: Set when `wardrobe_gap=true`. Locked vocab of 4 codes; v1 raises only `cold_weather_no_outerwear` and `hot_weather_no_lightwear`. Rain/formal reserved for v2.

tier_pools_partial.title: Tier Pools Partial
tier_pools_partial.description: True when fewer than 3 tier pools (safe / elevated / exploratory) could be filled — e.g. wardrobe too small to cover all tiers. Null-safe: defaults False so existing callers are unaffected.

photo_b64.title: Photo B64
photo_b64.description: Base64-encoded JPEG/PNG, max 5MB encoded. Processed in memory only — never stored to disk.

event_metadata.title: Event Metadata
event_metadata.description: Optional client-side context (e.g. screen_origin). Max 20 keys, string values <= 200 chars.

FeedbackRequest.title: FeedbackRequest
FeedbackRequest.description:
Post-wear feedback for one outfit.

At least one of `text` or `photo_b64` must be provided. The router
enforces this rule (400) so a body-less submission produces a clear
error instead of a silent no-op LLM call.

`photo_b64` is processed in memory only — never written to disk and
never persisted. LLM-2 extracts structured signals; the raw photo
is discarded after the call returns.

fit_preference.title: Fit Preference
fit_preference.description: Slim Fit | Classic Fit | Relaxed Fit

style_preferences.title: Style Preferences
style_preferences.description: Ordered 2-3 styles from the 5-vocab. First = highest weight.

source.title: Source
source.description: Provenance of this item in the outfit. `"user"` for items from the caller's wardrobe; `"common_essential"` for SYSTEM common items injected by the climate-starved fallback (Spec v2 §4.4). Defaults to `"user"` for backward compat.

outfit_hash.title: Outfit Hash
outfit_hash.description: Stable 12-char SHA-256 prefix over sorted item IDs.

tier_role.title: Tier Role
tier_role.description: LLM-1 tier assignment for this outfit slot. One of safe / elevated / exploratory. Null when the V05 LLM-1 tier layer is not engaged (e.g. pre-Phase-1 engine path).

engine_score.title: Engine Score
engine_score.description: Raw composite score assigned by the engine pipeline (L2 base × L4 mood mult × L5 novelty mult × common-injected penalty). Mirrors `score` — exposed separately so eval tooling can read the pre-tier-assignment value without depending on field aliasing.

outfit_hash.title: Outfit Hash
outfit_hash.description: Stable 12-char SHA-256 prefix over sorted item IDs.

tier_role.title: Tier Role
tier_role.description: LLM-1 tier assignment for this outfit slot. One of safe / elevated / exploratory. Null when the V05 LLM-1 tier layer is not engaged (e.g. pre-Phase-1 engine path).

engine_score.title: Engine Score
engine_score.description: Raw composite score assigned by the engine pipeline (L2 base × L4 mood mult × L5 novelty mult × common-injected penalty). Mirrors `score` — exposed separately so eval tooling can read the pre-tier-assignment value without depending on field aliasing.

OutfitWithHash.title: OutfitWithHash
OutfitWithHash.description:
Outfit payload carried in `/try_another` responses.

Inherits the full typed shape of `OutfitDTO` (items, vibe_signature,
reasoning_human, reasoning_debug, score, outfit_hash). Phase 1 used a
structural placeholder with `extra="allow"`; Phase 2 tightens to the
canonical typed shape.

build_ts.title: Build Ts
build_ts.description: When the Build response was received on device. Server computes time-to-decision = picked_ts - build_ts.

event_metadata.title: Event Metadata
event_metadata.description: Optional client-side context (e.g. tier_role of pick). Max 20 keys, string values <= 200 chars.

PickEventRequest.title: PickEventRequest
PickEventRequest.description: User picked one of the served outfits.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password must be at least 6 characters

axis.description: Client-driven axis. If null, engine picks via cycle.

pinned_item_id.title: Pinned Item Id
pinned_item_id.description: Item ID to keep across the variation, when provided.

wardrobe_gap.title: Wardrobe Gap
wardrobe_gap.description: True when engine recompose cannot fill the climate-starved slot even with SYSTEM common items. When True, `outfit` is null and the client should render a wardrobe-gap CTA per `wardrobe_gap_reason` (Spec v2 §4.6).

wardrobe_gap_reason.description: Set when `wardrobe_gap=true`. Locked vocab of 4 codes; v1 raises only `cold_weather_no_outerwear` and `hot_weather_no_lightwear`.

TryAnotherResponse.title: TryAnotherResponse
TryAnotherResponse.description:
Response for `POST /api/v05/recommendation/try_another`.

`outfit` is Optional to model the exhausted-and-recompose-failed case
(fallback=True, fallback_flags populated).

UserMetadataSchema.title: UserMetadataSchema
UserMetadataSchema.description: Validated schema for user_metadata JSON field

WardrobeGapReason.title: WardrobeGapReason
WardrobeGapReason.description:
User-actionable wardrobe deficiency. v1 raises only the first two.

Rain + formal codes reserved in enum for forward-compat (mobile copy map
covers all four). Engine code paths added in a follow-up ticket.

WearEventRequest.title: WearEventRequest
WearEventRequest.description: User marked outfit as worn (24h prompt response).

tier_pools_after_pretag.title: Tier Pools After Pretag
tier_pools_after_pretag.description: Per-tier pool sizes after pre-tag filtering (safe / elevated / exploratory). Null when LLM-1 tier layer is not engaged.

llm1_call.title: Llm1 Call
llm1_call.description: LLM-1 call trace. Shape: {source, latency_ms, fallback, fallback_reason, cache_hit}. Null when LLM-1 was not invoked.

anchor_diversity_score.title: Anchor Diversity Score
anchor_diversity_score.description: Number of distinct anchor items across primary + alternate outfits (Phase 0 metric). Used as Phase 1 LLM-1 readiness gate (>=3 distinct anchors in top 20). Null on the wardrobe-gap path.

anchor_diversity_pool_size.title: Anchor Diversity Pool Size
anchor_diversity_pool_size.description: Total outfits (primary + alternates) considered when computing `anchor_diversity_score`. Null on the wardrobe-gap path.
